competency.title: Validate sample size — simulated task
competency.outcome: Validate a claim about sample size using a prospective power and precision worksheet. Use a seeded simulation with an explicit environment version.

topic_kernel.artifact: a prospective power and precision worksheet
topic_kernel.measure: required sample size under stated effect

competency.practice_task: Produce a preregistered test protocol and evidence record grounded in a prospective power and precision worksheet.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a seeded simulation with an explicit environment version.
required_evidence: a preregistered test protocol and evidence record
Include the simulator config, seed band and baseline run.
Report required sample size under stated effect with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: claiming significance after repeated peeking.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of sample size.
Practice: a held-out challenge supports or rejects the claim.
Measurement: report required sample size under stated effect against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for claiming significance after repeated peeking; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
